description: Hand-labelled ground truth for VulnAgent evaluation. One entry per real vulnerability. Files listed under samples/ with no entries are expected to be clean, and any finding in them counts as a false positive.
line_convention: 1-based line of the vulnerable sink (the call that performs the unsafe operation), not the tainted assignment above it.

labels.note: f-string interpolation of request path parameter into cursor.execute
user input embedded in a template string then render_template_string
open() on an unvalidated query parameter
subprocess with shell=True and interpolated query parameter
binds 0.0.0.0, exposing the dev server on all interfaces
requests.get on a caller-supplied URL with no allow-list
md5 used to hash a password, unsalted
random.choice for a security token instead of secrets
ElementTree.fromstring on untrusted XML without entity expansion protection (CWE-776)
